current_answer: Choose the lowest layer that can safely execute the marketing job: Mautic for self-hosted marketing operations, Activepieces CE for reviewed cross-system flows, Marketing Agent OS for harness-based planning, and Loopmark only for a constrained local draft pilot.

catalogue_card.question: Which open-source marketing projects, AI agents and harnesses are worth using, and for which tasks?
catalogue_card.text: A four-layer starter shortlist with conditional choices, explicit boundaries and a draft-only first-test rule.

summary: Mautic and Activepieces CE are conditional choices for teams able to operate their respective platform or workflow layers.
Marketing Agent OS is a portable harness library, not a marketing application.
Loopmark remains exploratory because reviewed evidence leaves operational and governance gaps.
The public research library now compiles the comparison into individual dated dossiers without adding untested claims.
uncertainty: No hands-on installation or connector test was performed.
License labels are component-scoped, not legal advice.
Individual connectors, permissions, costs and data paths require separate verification.
freshness_note: Primary sources were checked for this bootstrap report on 22 September 2026; release and integration details can change.
